title: Eric Goat Horns (Jurassic Park 3)
description: This pack changes the goat horns to each be a unique scream of Amanda Kirby screaming "Eric!"
body: This pack is a joke our family had after watching Jurrasic Park III. We thought it was funny how many times Amanda Kirby screamed Eric's name. So we decided to turn it into a resource pack. Now you can scream Eric in your world with goat horns!
